items.source: Looks in various places for a properties file to extract loader settings, defaulting to loader.properties either on the current classpath or in the current working directory. The name of the properties file can be changed by setting a System property loader.config.name (e.g. -Dloader.config.name=my will look for my.properties. If that file doesn't exist then tries loader.config.location (with allowed prefixes classpath: and file: or any valid URL). Once that file is located turns it into Properties and extracts optional values (which can also be provided overridden as System properties in case the file doesn't exist):
items.translation: 在多个位置查找属性文件以提取加载器设置，默认情况下在当前类路径或当前工作目录中查找 loader.properties`。可以通过设置系统属性 loader.config.name` 来更改属性文件的名称（例如，-Dloader.config.name=my` 将查找 my.properties`）。如果该文件不存在，则尝试使用 loader.config.location`（允许的前缀为 classpath:` 和 file:` 或任何有效的 URL）。一旦找到该文件，将其转换为 Properties 对象并提取可选值（如果文件不存在，这些值也可以作为系统属性提供覆盖）：

items.source: Properties key for home directory. This is the location of external configuration if not on classpath, and also the base path for any relative paths in the loader path. Defaults to current working directory ( ${user.dir}).
items.translation: 主目录的 Properties 键。如果外部配置不在类路径中，这是其位置，同时也是 加载器路径 中任何相对路径的基础路径。默认为当前工作目录 (${user.dir})。

items.source: Properties key for name of external configuration file (excluding suffix). Defaults to "application". Ignored if loader config location is provided instead.
items.translation: 外部配置文件名称的 Properties 键（不包括后缀）。默认为"application"。如果提供了加载器配置位置，则会被忽略。

items.source: Return the archive being launched or null if there is no archive.
items.translation: 返回正在启动的存档，或者如果没有存档则返回null。

items.source: Properties key for main class. As a manifest entry can also be specified as Start-Class.
items.translation: 主类的属性键。作为清单条目，也可指定为 Start-Class`。

items.source: Properties key for classpath entries (directories possibly containing jars or jars). Multiple entries can be specified using a comma-separated list. BOOT-INF/classes,BOOT-INF/lib in the application archive are always used.
items.translation: 类路径条目（可能包含 jar 或 jar）的属性键。可以使用逗号分隔列表指定多个条目。BOOT-INF/classes,BOOT-INF/lib 始终在应用程序归档中使用。

items.source:
Properties key for config file location (including optional classpath:, file: or
URL prefix).
items.translation: 配置文件中属性键（包括可选的类路径前缀：classpath:、文件前缀：file: 或 URL 前缀）。

items.source:
Properties key for boolean flag (default false) which, if set, will cause the
external configuration properties to be copied to System properties (assuming that
is allowed by Java security).
items.translation: 布尔标志的 Properties 键（默认值为 false），如果设置该值，则会将外部配置属性复制到系统属性中（前提是 Java 安全策略允许）。

items.source: Create a classloader for the specified archives.
items.translation: 为指定的归档文件创建类加载器。

items.source: Returns the archives that will be used to construct the class path.
items.translation: 返回将用于构建类路径的归档文件。

items.source: Returns the main class that should be launched.
items.translation: 返回应启动的主类。

items.source:
Properties key for default command line arguments. These arguments (if present) are
prepended to the main method arguments before launching.
items.translation: 默认命令行参数的 Properties 键。如果存在这些参数，它们将在启动前附加到主方法参数之前。

items.source: loader.main: the main method to delegate execution to once the class loader is set up. No default, but will fall back to looking for a Start-Class in a MANIFEST.MF, if there is one in ${loader.home}/META-INF.
items.translation: `loader.main`：类加载器设置好后，将委托执行的主方法。没有默认值，但如果 `${loader.home}/META-INF` 中存在一个 `MANIFEST.MF`，则会回退到查找其中的 Start-Class`。

items.source: loader.path: a comma-separated list of directories (containing file resources and/or nested archives in *.jar or *.zip or archives) or archives to append to the classpath. BOOT-INF/classes,BOOT-INF/lib in the application archive are always used
items.translation: loader.path：一个逗号分隔的目录列表（包含文件资源，和/或嵌套在 *.jar 或 *.zip 或归档中的归档），用于追加到类路径。应用程序归档中的 BOOT-INF/classes,BOOT-INF/lib 始终被使用。
